cases.check: verify exact exam/question and source page; never require maximum rating
package model_answer has page reference, no extracted answer text; use existing private source, no reupload
label synthetic; test misreading, missing premise, contradiction; never label official
utilitarianism 3 to 4 must match actual added reasoning; four unchanged criteria
only corrected issues improve; unchanged errors remain
no automatic growth; repeated evaluation needs Owner approval

verdicts.PASS: core assessment and feedback supported by official evidence
verdicts.PARTIAL: core valid but specific correction needed
verdicts.FAIL: major reasoning, source or quotation error

proposed_provider_test.scope: one A-G evaluation plus independent review each; only after source readiness and explicit approval
proposed_provider_test.cost: recalculate using approved model current price and token caps before requesting approval
proposed_provider_test.output: private QA artifact, never student History
proposed_provider_test.retry: no automatic extra calls; preserve failed case evidence

expansion: Hanyang Owner quality review first, then existing prioritized universities; reuse private PDFs, verified packages and existing admin QA. No mass activation.
